summary: Approved for clean Linux cook/package validation. The DefaultEngine.ini LinuxTargetSettings change is syntactically valid UE config, is placed under the correct section, removes the inherited BaseEngine.ini SF_VULKAN_SM5 array entry, adds SF_VULKAN_SM6, and sets bEnableRayTracing=True in the Linux platform config section consumed by UE 5.5 UBT. No blocker findings were found in the scoped config diff.
work_completed: Reviewed cpp/unreal_projects/SpearSim/Config/DefaultEngine.ini lines 264-267 and confirmed the section is exactly [/Script/LinuxTargetPlatform.LinuxTargetSettings] with -TargetedRHIs=SF_VULKAN_SM5, +TargetedRHIs=SF_VULKAN_SM6, and bEnableRayTracing=True.
Confirmed there is only one LinuxTargetSettings section in the project config and no duplicate/conflicting Linux TargetedRHIs entries elsewhere under cpp/unreal_projects/SpearSim/Config.

Checked UE 5.5.4 local source: Linux TargetedRHIs are read from /Script/LinuxTargetPlatform.LinuxTargetSettings, and UEBuildLinux.cs declares bEnableRayTracing with ConfigHierarchyType.Engine for the same section.

Confirmed BaseEngine.ini has [/Script/LinuxTargetPlatform.LinuxTargetSettings] +TargetedRHIs=SF_VULKAN_SM5, so the project-level -TargetedRHIs followed by +TargetedRHIs should override the inherited SM5 default for BuildCookRun.
Ran git diff --check for DefaultEngine.ini with no output and verified the file still ends with a newline.

findings.message: Approved: cpp/unreal_projects/SpearSim/Config/DefaultEngine.ini:264-267 is in the correct LinuxTargetSettings section. UE config array remove/add syntax is appropriate here: -TargetedRHIs=SF_VULKAN_SM5 removes the inherited BaseEngine.ini Linux default and +TargetedRHIs=SF_VULKAN_SM6 adds the required Vulkan SM6 target.

Approved: bEnableRayTracing=True belongs in /Script/LinuxTargetPlatform.LinuxTargetSettings for UE 5.5 Linux UBT. Local source /home/yashturkar/Linux_Unreal_Engine_5.5.4/Engine/Source/Programs/UnrealBuildTool/Platform/Linux/UEBuildLinux.cs:108 binds bEnableRayTracing to that Engine config section.

The wider workspace is dirty outside this scoped review, including control-tower state, examples/flashlight files, and tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py. The reviewed DefaultEngine.ini diff itself is limited to 5 insertions in the requested file, so this is not a blocker for the config approval but Tower should not treat the whole worktree as clean.
No recook/package/runtime validation was performed, per task instructions. The next validation must prove the staged package actually uses VULKAN_SM6 rather than only confirming the config text.

follow_up_recommendations: Route Experimenter for a clean Linux cook/package, for example: python tools/run_uat.py --unreal-engine-dir /home/yashturkar/Linux_Unreal_Engine_5.5.4 --clean-archive-dir --cook-maps /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/cafeteria_500sqft_v2/Maps/cafeteria_500sqft_v2 /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/cafeteria_500sqft_v2/Maps/cafeteria_500sqft_v2_flashlight_validation_dark -clean -cook -stage -package -archive -pak -skipbuild.

Expected cook/package signatures: cook logs and pak listing should show VULKAN_SM6 shader autogen/global shader cache, especially Engine/GlobalShaderCache-VULKAN_SM6.bin, and should not stage only GlobalShaderCache-VULKAN_SM5.bin.

Expected runtime signatures after packaging: Vulkan profile check for VP_UE_Vulkan_SM6 or SM6_RT, Platform=VULKAN_SM6, ray tracing enabled dynamically, ray tracing shaders enabled, and flashlight HWRT CVar readback confirmed=true. Negative signatures remain Platform=VULKAN_SM5 or 'Ray tracing is disabled. Reason: not supported by current RHI.'
